stem: Immune repertoire reconstitution after HSCT depends on many factors. Which of the following statements is wrong?

options.A: Conditioning regimen influences both short-term and long-term immune reconstitution.
options.B: The pharmacokinetics of ATG is highly dependent on receptor load represented by absolute lymphocyte count. Therefore, some studies adopt to dose ATC on lymphocyte count rather than body weight.
options.C: Higher numbers of NKT and αβT cells in the graft have been reported to associate with favorable immune reconstitution, most likely due to their impact on controlling GVHD and acting on CMV and on leukemia.
options.D: Measuring the production of cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors represents an integral part of immunomonitoring after HSCT.

ebmt_chapters: Ch10 Clinical and Biological Concepts for Mastering Immune Reconstitution After Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: Toward Practical Guidelines and Greater Harmonization (PDF p118–130)

stem: Which of the following statements regarding the purposes of conditioning therapy prior to the infusion of stem cell grafts is incorrect?

options.A: To eradicate the hematologic malignancy in case of malignant indication for HSCT.
options.B: To provide sufficient immunosuppression to ensure engraftment and to prevent both rejection and GVHD.
options.C: To provide stem cell niches in the host BM for the new stem cells.
options.D: Myelo-depletion is the prerequisite to ensure the engraftment of infused stem cells.

stem: Which of the following statement regarding the use of ATG in allotransplant is correct?

options.A: ATG has been demonstrated to decrease acute GVHD after unrelated transplant but not effective in reducing chronic GVHD.
options.B: ATG is recommended for prophylaxis of GVHD in patients receiving MUD transplant only.
options.C: ATG is not recommended in patients receiving MRD allotransplant who are at high risk of GVHD.
options.D: CMV reactivation is frequently seen after the use of ATG in Taiwan adult patients.
options.E: All of the above are correct.

stem: Which of the following statement regarding reduced intensity conditioning (RIC) or nonmyeloablative conditioning (NMA) in allotransplant is NOT true?

options.C: RIC resulted in lower TRM but higher relapse rate compared with MAC in patients with AML and MDS.
options.D: Outcomes are usually better in RIC than MAC in patients with advanced disease.
